profile: Pyxis Oncology is a clinical-stage company developing treatments for solid tumors, with an immediate focus on head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Its lead investigational candidate, micvotabart pelidotin, is an antibody-drug conjugate designed to target a fibronectin variant in the tumor microenvironment and deliver a drug payload. The candidate is being studied alone and in combination with pembrolizumab.
